# ANCBuddy 2.1.0
ANCBuddy 2.1.0 adds Immersive Audio controls for compatible QC Ultra devices.
Switch between Still and Motion directly inside the active Immersion card, read the headphones' live setting, and get clear confirmation while each change is applied.
Devices without a supported Immersive Audio protocol path keep the existing Quiet, Aware, Immersion, battery, and AI Auto-EQ controls unchanged.
If you still have the old BoseControl app installed, quit and remove it after installing ANCBuddy to avoid two menu bar apps competing for the same headphones.
